blocks.text: Gravitational wave space ka khinchna aur dabna (stretching aur compressing) hai; isay do cheezon ke darmiyan lambai (faasle) ki tabdeeli naap kar dekha ja sakta hai.
Gravitational waves (GWs) asal mein yeh hain:

blocks.title: Gravitational waves
blocks.text: Spacetime (space aur waqt ke mile jule kapre) mein lehrein (ripples), jo shadeed kaainati waqiaat, jaise black holes ya neutron stars ke takrane, se paida hoti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki maloomat saath le jati hain.

blocks.title: Albert Einstein (1879-1955)
blocks.text: Germany mein paida hone wale theoretical physicist; duniya ke sab se mashhoor aur asar-andaz scientists mein se ek.
GWs samajhne ki sab se aasan misal yeh hai:

Agar hum talab mein patthar phenkein to pani ki satah (spacetime) par lehrein banti hain. Yeh lehrein bahar ki taraf phailti hain aur patthar (kaainati waqiye) ki maloomat saath le jati hain. Kinare par (gravitational wave observatories mein) inhein pakar kar patthar ke hone aur us ki khoobiyon ka pata chalta hai.
Peshgoi (prediction) aur daryaft (detection)

Gravitational waves Einstein ki general theory of relativity ki peshgoi hain, jo mushahidaat (observations) se sabit ho chuki hai, aur kaainat ke sab se shadeed waqiaat ko dekhne ka naya darwaza khol rahi hain.

Einstein ki general theory of relativity ke mutabiq gravity koi force nahi balke bhaari ajsaam (massive bodies) ki wajah se spacetime ka mur jana (curvature) hai. Gravity gadde (mattress) mein bane gaddhe jaisi hai: bhaari cheezein apne ird-gird space ko mor deti (warp karti) hain, isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain. (Kitab mein “wrap” chhapa hai; matlab warp, yani morna.)

Gravitational waves ki peshgoi Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein ki thi. Yeh spacetime ki lehrein pehli baar 2015 mein pakri gayin, jab scientists ne is qism ke pehle mushahide ka elaan kiya. Is qism (do ajsaam ke qareeb aate hue) mein waves ki frequency aur amplitude dheere dheere barhte jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke 2015 ki pehli daryaft do takrate neutron stars se paida hone wali waves thin. Yeh ghalat hai: 14 September 2015 ko LIGO ne jo pehli gravitational waves pakrin woh do black holes ke milne (merger) se aayi thin, jaisa isi kitab ka topic 8.7 bhi kehta hai. Neutron stars ke takrao se waves pehli baar 2017 mein pakri gayin.

Gravitational waves ke silsile mein Binary System (BS) se murad aisa nizam hai jis mein do compact (bohat ghane) ajsaam, jaise black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs, ek doosre ke gird ghoom rahe hon aur gravitational waves kharij kar rahe hon.

blocks.title: Dr. Nergis Mavalvala
blocks.text: Dr. Nergis Mavalvala Pakistani-American astrophysicist hain jo MIT mein gravitational waves par apne kaam ki wajah se mashhoor hain.
Gravitational waves ki chaar bunyadi qismein
Gravitational waves ki chaar bunyadi qismein hain, har ek ke sources aur khoobiyan alag hain:
1. Continuous GWs

Jab koi akela bhaari jism, jaise neutron star, ek hi raftar se ghoome (spin kare) to ek hi frequency aur amplitude wali continuous GWs banti hain. White dwarf binary systems bhi continuous GWs banate hain.
2. Compact binary inspiral GWs

Jab binary system, jaise do neutron stars, do black holes, ya ek neutron star aur ek black hole, ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hue andar ki taraf ghoom kar (spiral) qareeb aate hain, to compact binary inspiral GWs banti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Inspirational” likha hai. Sahi lafz “inspiral” hai: do ajsaam gravitational waves mein energy khote hue chakkar kha kar ek doosre ke qareeb aate (spiral in) hain. “Inspirational” ka matlab hausla dene wala hai, jo yahan ghalat hai.
3. Burst GWs
Yeh shadeed waqiaat, jaise supernova (sitare ka phatna), gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings, se paida hoti hain.
4. Stochastic GWs

Stochastic GWs kamzor aur be-tarteeb (random) signals hain jo bohat se kamzor sources, jaise door ke binary systems, ki waves ke aapas mein milne (superposition) se bante hain. Inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

Har accelerate karne wala jism gravitational waves paida karta hai, gariyan aur hawai jahaz bhi. Lekin Zameen par cheezon ka mass aur acceleration itne kam hain ke un ki waves hamare instruments se pakri ja sakne jitni bari nahi hotin.

Jab binary systems (binaries) ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain to gravitational waves kharij karte hain, jinhein LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory, USA) aur Virgo (Cascina, Italy ki bari observatory) jaisi observatories pakar sakti hain. Yeh waves system ke mass, spin aur milap (merger) ki maloomat laati hain aur light ki speed se chalti hain.
Binary systems gravitational waves ke bare sources hain, aur un ka merger (do bhaari ajsaam ka takra kar ek zyada bhaari jism ban jana) kaainat ke sab se shadeed waqiaat mein se hai.

Jab masses ghoomte aur accelerate karte hain to un ki gravitational shiddat badalti hai, aur har simt mein bahar phailne wali waves banti hain. Yeh waves binary system ki gravity mein qaid nahi rehtin; light ki speed se spacetime mein azadi se chalti hain aur source se door jate hue kamzor hoti jati hain.

blocks.alt: Two dark bodies orbiting each other at the centre of many concentric blue circles, with arrows pointing outward: gravitational waves spreading out from a binary system.
blocks.caption: Binary system se phailti gravitational waves (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan ek tasveer deti hai jis mein binary system markaz mein hai aur kurre (spheres) bahar phailte hain. Yeh saada khaaka wohi baat dikhata hai: do bhaari ajsaam ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain aur un se lehrein light ki speed se har simt mein bahar jati hain, door ja kar kamzor hoti hain.
GWs ki khoobiyan system ki in baaton par depend karti hain:

items: orbit ki eccentricity: eccentricity ε batati hai ke rasta mukammal daire (circle) se kitna hat-ta hai.

blocks.text: Spacetime distortion / tidal forces

Mass wale jism se guzarne wali gravitational waves jism ko baar baar khinchne aur dabne par majboor karti hain; isay “spacetime distortion” kehte hain. Is asar ko “tidal forces” bhi kehte hain aur yeh wave ke jhoolne (oscillating) ki wajah se hai. Wave jism ke ird-gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, jis se jism wave ki simt ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai. Yeh waisa hi hai jaise Chand aur Suraj ki kashish se Zameen par samandar mein madd-o-jazar (tides) aate hain.

blocks.alt: Four rings of small masses at t = 0, T/4, T/2 and 3T/4 as a gravitational wave passes into the page: a circle, an ellipse stretched sideways and squeezed vertically, a circle again, and an ellipse stretched vertically and squeezed sideways.
blocks.caption: Guzarti gravitational wave mein azad masses ka daira khinchta aur dabta hai (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Wave page ke andar ja rahi hai. Us ki simt ke perpendicular plane mein jism ek taraf khinchta aur doosri taraf dabta hai, phir aadhe period baad ulta. Yahi baar baar khinchao aur dabao (tidal effect) hai.
Khinchao aur dabao ki miqdar wave ki taqat aur jism ke mass aur size par depend karti hai. Yeh asar Einstein ki general relativity ki ek ahem peshgoi hai.

Door ke falaki (celestial) waqiaat, jaise do black holes ya neutron stars ke merger, ki waves Zameen se bhi guzarti hain. Lekin in ka amplitude bohat chhota hai (strain taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²²), is liye in se hone wali tabdeeli intehai chhoti hai aur intehai hassas (sensitive) instruments chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab amplitude ko “10⁻²¹ to 10⁻²² metres” likhti hai. Gravitational wave ka amplitude strain hai, yani lambai mein fractional tabdeeli (ΔL/L), jis ka koi unit nahi. LIGO ke 4 km lambe arms mein yeh tabdeeli sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁸ m hoti hai (4000 m × 10⁻²¹).

Chhote amplitude ke bawajood gravitational waves kaainat ko dekhne ka anokha darwaza hain: in se taqatwar gravity (strong-field gravity) parhi ja sakti hai, general relativity ko test kiya ja sakta hai, aur kaainat ko un tareeqon se dekha ja sakta hai jo pehle mumkin nahi the.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves kya hain, kis ne un ki peshgoi ki, aur tidal forces kaise bante hain (MCQ 8.10, 8.11, 8.13; constructed response 8.6)?
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime mein lehrein hain jin ki peshgoi Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein general relativity se ki; yeh zyada tar accelerate karte bhaari ajsaam, jaise black holes ke merger, se paida hoti hain. Jab wave kisi jism se guzarti hai to us ke gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, to jism wave ki simt ke perpendicular baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai; yahi tidal forces hain, jaise Chand aur Suraj Zameen par tides banate hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Gravitational waves: shadeed kaainati waqiaat se spacetime mein lehrein, light ki speed se; Einstein ki 1916 ki peshgoi; pehli daryaft 2015 (do black holes ka merger).
Chaar qismein: continuous, compact binary inspiral, burst, stochastic. Binary systems sab se bare sources hain; waves mass, spin aur merger ki maloomat laati hain.
Tidal forces: guzarti wave jism ko us ki simt ke perpendicular khinchti aur dabati hai; strain sirf 10⁻²¹ ke qareeb, is liye LIGO jaise hassas instruments chahiye.
